definitions.explanation: receiving new inventory of a previously sold-out item; the item becoming available again for purchase

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}{商品|しょうひん}→人気商品：21609_ninkishouhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{再|さい}{入荷|にゅうか}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The popular item is back in stock.

examples.japanese: {再|さい}{入荷|にゅうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Set up a notification for when it's restocked.

examples.japanese: {再|さい}{入荷|にゅうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧です。

notes:
SHOPPING/RETAIL TERM:
{再|さい}{入荷|にゅうか} is commonly seen in online shopping and retail contexts when previously sold-out items become available again.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再|さい}{入荷|にゅうか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be restocked
- {再|さい}{入荷|にゅうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧ - restock notification
- {再|さい}{入荷|にゅうか}{待|ま}ち - waiting for restock
- {再|さい}{入荷|にゅうか}⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧ - restock date undetermined

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{入荷|にゅうか}→入荷：07939_nyuuka⟧ - stock arrival, receiving goods
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧ - inventory, stock
- ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧ - sold out
- ⟦{完売|かんばい}→完売：18954_kanbai⟧ - sold out completely
